article.story: WEST LAFAYETTE, Ind. -- — Freshman Antione West Jr. scored a season-high 27 points, Daniel Jacobsen had 19 points, 12 rebounds and seven assists, and Purdue held off Lipscomb 95-78 on Tuesday night for its third win in a row. Purdue built a big lead by going on a 27-2 run midway through the first half while Lipscomb was 1 of 11 from the field. Purdue's lead was trimmed to 51-36 at the break — its highest scoring first half of the season — after Lipscomb scored the final seven points. Lipscomb went on a 10-0 run midway through the second half to get within 66-59 — the first single-digit deficit since the opening six minutes of the game. Takai Simpkins converted a three-point play after a Purdue turnover to trim it to 74-69 with eight minutes left. But Jacobsen and C.J. Cox combined for all 11 of Purdue's points during an 11-3 run to go ahead 83-72. West sealed it on a 3-pointer from the corner for an 89-75 lead with 2:47 left. Gicarri Harris added 16 points for Purdue (3-2), which also has wins over Illinois State and Ohio. Cox finished with 12 and Jack Benter had 11. Simpkins scored 22 points for Lipscomb (3-3), which was picked third in the preseason Atlantic Sun poll. Mateo Esmeraldo had 19 points and eight assists. Up next Lipscomb: Plays at Alabama A&M on Friday. Purdue: End a five-game homestand on Friday against Oakland. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
